things.title: Clownin’ Around
things.description: A punk band where everyone is a clown! I know there’s already a band that dresses like clowns, OK? This is different. First, they ARE clowns; it’s not a costume. Second,they aren’t scary goth clowns. They are traditional clowns with polkadots and red noses and big shoes. Maybe one of them is a sad clown. Maybe one is a hobo clown. Their music is pretty standard punk but it’s only about clowns. Note: Clownin’ Around is staunchly against the use of animals in circuses because who needs animals when you have CLOWNS?!
